A_extra.issue: Joule heating exclusion rests on one two-temperature comparison; asks for a quantitative thermal model (SiO2/Si, T-dependent kappa, Kapitza) with an order-of-magnitude dT estimate
Temperature independence of Pd and rd is unexplained by the authors' own model, since rho_c and tau should vary between 0.4 and 5.6 K; state Tc
Sharpen the Joule versus non-equilibrium distinction (thermalized versus athermal energy) and name an observable that separates them
Eq. (1) uses a 3D isotropic Green's function; a 20 nm film is 2D (K0) and the oxide is layered; refit with alternative forms, report residuals
Lambert-W fit cannot discriminate mechanisms; asks for parameter-free predictions for the corner and floating geometries of Fig. 4d,e
Definition of r0 (from gate apex or island edge), implied threshold power from the 80 nm offset, inclusion of the zero-power point
Lifetime of ~1e-9 s in the abstract is conditional on an unresolved channel; floating-island result implies a substrate channel; athermal phonons ballistic
Link between uW-scale leakage regime and pW-nW transport GCS is assumed; show Ic(VG) and Ic(P) for nanowire D1
Confirm the 60 GOhm parasitic path contributes negligibly to P at relevant VG; state where device leakage dominates wiring leakage
Vortex expulsion at low power may be global warming reducing pinning; control raising bath temperature without gate power; field-cooled vortices affect the VG=0 reference map
'Complete suppression' not established given Pearl length ~2.9 um and nonlocal screening; smooth suppression profile; possible color-scale saturation in Fig. 2c, line cuts with model overlays
Fitted Pd differs by ~3x between D3 and D2b, contradicting 'reproducible for all devices'
'Nanoscale spatial region' wording versus a >1 um suppressed region; outlook mixes temperature and gap, no above-Tc data
Extended-gate FEM maps show field, not current density; state the leakage current-distribution model
Reference problems: Kivelson-Rokhsar citation for quasiparticles, Ref. [13] DOI/year mismatch, Ref. [18] missing year
Deposit raw scans and fit scripts in a public repository

B_extra.issue: Count devices fabricated, imaged and showing the effect per run, and cooldowns; say why any were set aside
Full parameter ranges measured and why the shown ranges were chosen; only one bias field B0 ~ 1 mT
Processing steps from raw data to figures, data and code availability
Show a D2a or D2b r0(P) dataset beside Fig. 3a in the main text and say how Fig. 2c and Fig. 4 scans were picked
Estimate the steady-state temperature rise for 1 to 4 uW at the gate apex and the predicted r0 shift; resistive-heater control as in Ritter et al. 2021
Give the simulated |E| at the island edge for the floating-island configuration of Fig. 4e to support excluding a direct field effect
Compare the uW powers with the gate power at which the transport critical current of nanowire D1 vanishes on the same film

notes: Scored the 15 first-round concerns outside presentation/clarity and novelty (C1-C4, C6-C9, C11, C14, C16, C17, C19, C21, C28). arXiv v1 matches the first-round manuscript (no laser paragraph in Methods, room-temperature diffusivity still used, Fig. 3b unchanged), so fixed_in_v1 is false throughout. Neither review raised the laser-related concerns (C2, C3, C4) or the single-film concern (C21). A is stronger on fit/analysis issues (C9, C16, C17 raised); B raised the r0-versus-VG correlation (C7) most directly and questioned the polarity argument (C28, partly, via a different mechanism than hole injection). Both questioned the Joule-heating exclusion, which no referee raised as such. Borderline calls: A on C8 and C6 rest on the same Fig. 3b request; A on C19 mentions the Pearl length for the corner effect, not for the fitted lambda.
